name: Brett Guthrie
stance: Wants federal preemption of state AI laws to avoid a patchwork of state rules; his committee wrote the 2025 moratorium.

statements.text: As Energy and Commerce chair, advanced the reconciliation text containing a 10-year moratorium on state and local AI laws out of committee on a party-line vote.
I was fine with it being shorter
We don't need to compete with Europe to regulate. We need to compete with China to innovate.

Praised the AI framework released by the Trump administration, joining a House Republican leadership statement committing to act on it, and said the U.S. will lead in AI innovation while protecting consumers and children's online safety.
